entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit. Your call may be recorded for quality assurance. Please hold for the next available agent.
Thank you for holding. You've reached VeloFit, my name is Isaac. How can I help you today?
Yeah, Isaac, I need to return this VeloBand Pulse. It's a complete waste of money and I want my refund now.

I'm very sorry to hear you're not satisfied with the product. I can definitely look into that for you. To make sure I understand, what specifically is the issue? Is it a technical fault or more of a preference?

Don't run me through a script! The whole thing is the issue. It's incredibly `hard to use`. The menu is so `confusing` I can't even find the settings I need. I've read the `user manual` twice and it's completely useless.
I understand the frustration. Sometimes those settings can be a bit tricky at first. I could walk you through setting up a custom workout display if you'd like?

Are you listening to me?! I don't want a tutorial, I want a refund! I `expected more` from a brand like VeloFit. This is a joke. Either you process this return or you get me your manager. I'm ready to post reviews about this disaster on every website I can find.
Okay, okay, no need for that, sir. My apologies. Let me just pull up your account and review the return eligibility. Can I get your order number?
Thank you... one moment. Okay, I see the order. It looks like the VeloBand was delivered on December 27th, so that's about 12 days ago.
And? Don't tell me I'm two days too late for some ridiculous policy.

Not at all, sir. I'm just looking at our policy here... and it says that all our items are eligible for return within 90 days of delivery. You're well within that window, so I can approve this for you right now for a full refund.
Well, finally. That's what I wanted to hear. So what's next?

I've just processed the return authorization. You'll be receiving an email shortly with a prepaid shipping label and instructions. Simply pack the device back in its original box, attach the label, and you can drop it off at any shipping center.
And I'll get the full amount back?
Yes, once our warehouse receives the item, a full refund will be issued to your original method of payment. You'll receive an email notification as soon as that's processed.
Fine. Good.
Was there anything else I could assist you with today?
No, that's it.
Alright. Thank you for calling VeloFit. Have a good rest of your day.
